_approach: Detroit electro-adjacent techno in the Drexciya/Underground Resistance lineage: an 808 kick with a syncopated skip (beat 3 of bar 2 is omitted and replaced by an off-16th hit) under a layered snare+clap doubled hit on 2 and 4 with a delay-throw simulated as decaying ghost repeats, a cowbell accent standing in for the genre's electro-funk cowbell hits, and a sparse clave. Light swing keeps the 808 groove from feeling programmed dead straight.
